title: Berberine Derivative Compound 13 as a Potent Promoter of Osteoblast Differentiation via Akt and PKC Signaling Pathways.
authors: Piao, Meiyu; Han, Youn Ho; Lee, Kwang Youl
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱衍生物促进成骨分化的信号通路，仅涉及小分子-激酶对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Berberine has been widely studied for its biological functions in various diseases, including cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. Nevertheless, structural modifications of berberine have been demonstrated to augment its pharmacological efficacy in specific biological processes, particularly osteogenesis. In this study, we aimed to explore new berberine derivatives with pro-osteogenic activity and molecular mechanisms. Our results demonstrated that compound 13 is the most effective among the tested compounds. Compound 13 significantly enhanced BMP4-induced alkaline phosphatase (ALP) staining and increased the transcriptional activity of osteogenic markers such as ALP, Runt-related gene 2 (Runx2), and Osterix at both the mRNA and protein levels. Furthermore, we found that the Akt and PKC signaling pathways play crucial roles in compound 13-induced osteogenesis via treatment with specific inhibitors. The molecular docking results supported the potential interaction between compound 13 and these kinases. These findings highlighted the regulatory role of compound 13 in osteoblast differentiation via the Akt and PKC signaling pathways. Overall, our study provides compelling evidence that compound 13 is a promising therapeutic candidate for the treatment of osteoporosis, with the potential for further development and optimization to improve bone health and strength.
abstract_zh: 小檗碱（berberine）已在多种疾病中被广泛研究其生物学功能，包括癌症、糖尿病和心血管疾病。然而，研究表明，对小檗碱进行结构修饰可增强其在特定生物过程中的药理功效，尤其是在成骨作用方面。在本研究中，我们旨在探索具有促成骨活性的新型小檗碱衍生物及其分子机制。我们的结果表明，化合物13在所测试的化合物中效果最为显著。化合物13显著增强了BMP4诱导的碱性磷酸酶（ALP）染色，并在mRNA和蛋白质水平上提高了成骨标志物如ALP、Runt相关基因2（Runx2）和Osterix的转录活性。此外，我们发现，通过特定抑制剂处理，Akt和PKC信号通路在化合物13诱导的成骨作用中发挥关键作用。分子对接结果支持化合物13与这些激酶之间的潜在相互作用。这些发现强调了化合物13通过Akt和PKC信号通路在成骨细胞分化中的调控作用。总体而言，我们的研究提供了有力证据，表明化合物13是治疗骨质疏松症的有前景的候选药物，并具有进一步开发和优化的潜力，以改善骨骼健康和强度。
